clause_name: RLA-450 — Residential Lease — Packages and Mail
library_question: Does the standard mail-forwarding, delivery-instruction, package-retrieval, and no-custody language apply?

blocks.text: Tenant is responsible for forwarding mail, giving delivery instructions, and promptly retrieving packages. Unless Landlord expressly accepts custody in writing, Landlord does not take custody of mail or packages. Nothing in this section exculpates or limits liability imposed by law.
